trip.title: The Iberian Grand Tour
trip.subtitle: The Lisbon Loop + Oasis UK Finale
trip.route: Lisbon · Porto · Madrid · Barcelona · Seville · Lisbon · London · Manchester · London

travelers.name: Jennie
travelers.note: Flies LAX to Heathrow overnight Jun 8, lands midday Jun 9

trip.summary: A nonstop to Lisbon opens the Iberian leg, then the Alfa Pendular up to Porto, a short flight to Madrid, the AVE to Barcelona, Seville, and a final Lisbon night. Nonstop to London on Jun 8, Avanti to Manchester for back-to-back Oasis shows at the Etihad (Fri Jun 11 and Sat Jun 12), then a 3-night London encore before flying home Jun 16.
trip.disclaimer: Fares and rates are researched estimates as of October 2026 for May-June 2027 travel and will vary with booking date and availability. US citizens need no visa for stays under 90 days; the EU's ETIAS authorization (about 7 EUR online) is expected to be required by 2027 - confirm before departure. Travel insurance with medical coverage recommended.

stays.blurb: Explorer-themed Autograph boutique in the heart of Chiado. Santa Justa lift 6 min, Praca do Comercio 8 min on foot. 87 rooms, acclaimed Rocco restaurant and a lively gin bar. About 40-60k Bonvoy points/night.
Porto's newest Bonvoy flagship: rooftop 17m infinity pool and bar, full spa with indoor pool. Clerigos Tower, Livraria Lello and Casa da Musica all within walking distance.

stays.hotel: The Palace, a Luxury Collection Hotel
stays.blurb: The 1912 Belle Epoque icon with the famous stained-glass rotunda, directly across from the Prado on Plaza de Neptuno. Best-located Marriott in Madrid. Alt: W Madrid (Canalejas) or the Madrid EDITION.

19th-century Cotton Guild headquarters with a famous spiral staircase, L'Atelier terrace and garden restaurant. Casa Batllo is four blocks up. Alt: Le Meridien Barcelona (La Rambla) or the Barcelona EDITION.

Design boutique directly opposite the Gothic Cathedral, arguably the best address in Seville. Rooftop with Giralda views. Splurge alt: Hotel Alfonso XIII, Luxury Collection (post-Feria May rates EUR 550-850).
One familiar night before the UK leg: 15-minute taxi to the airport for the morning flight to London.

Grade II-listed 1922 County Hall on the South Bank. Rooms look across Westminster Bridge at Big Ben; 25m indoor pool, Gillray's Steakhouse, Waterloo station 3 minutes away. Jennie gets her own room from Jun 9. Alt: JW Marriott Grosvenor House.

Victorian Refuge Assurance building with a landmark clock tower and grand tiled lobby. 10-minute walk from Piccadilly station, steps from Oxford Road station and St Peter's Square tram stop for the Metrolink to the Etihad. One 2 Double Premium room for all three. Check-in 3 PM, check-out 12 PM; free cancellation until 7 days before arrival (Jun 3).
Return stay at County Hall before flying home from Heathrow on Jun 16.

days.title: Depart LAX
days.plan: Depart LAX 4:30 PM (Terminal B) on TAP TP248; dinner and lie-flat sleep aboard.

days.title: Arrive Lisbon
days.plan: Arrive 11:30 AM. Metro or taxi to Chiado. Gentle first evening: sunset at Miradouro de Santa Catarina, dinner in Chiado.

days.title: Belem
days.plan: Belem morning: Jeronimos Monastery, Belem Tower, warm pasteis de nata at the 1837 bakery. Afternoon MAAT or the Coach Museum.

days.title: Alfama and Fado
days.plan: Alfama and Sao Jorge Castle by tuk-tuk or Tram 28; Fado dinner in Bairro Alto, a short stroll uphill from Chiado.

days.title: Train to Porto
days.plan: Morning Alfa Pendular from Lisboa Oriente (~2h50, first class). Afternoon in the Ribeira's riverfront lanes, then across the Dom Luis I bridge for a port-lodge tasting in Vila Nova de Gaia.

days.title: Porto highlights
days.plan: Sao Bento station's azulejo hall, Livraria Lello and Clerigos Tower; lunch at Mercado do Bolhao; afternoon six-bridges Douro cruise; sunset at the rooftop infinity pool.

days.title: Fly to Madrid
days.plan: Morning nonstop from Porto to Madrid (1h15). Cercanias train to Atocha; the hotel faces the Neptune fountain, 6 minutes away. Afternoon: Retiro Park and the Crystal Palace; tapas on Cava Baja.

days.title: Prado and Thyssen
days.plan: The Prado with a pre-booked guide (Velazquez, Goya); afternoon Thyssen-Bornemisza. Both are directly across the street from The Palace.

days.title: Royal Palace and flamenco
days.plan: Royal Palace and Almudena Cathedral. Evening flamenco at Corral de la Moreria.

days.title: Toledo day trip
days.plan: Toledo day trip by AVE from Atocha (33 min each way): cathedral, El Greco, medieval lanes.

days.title: AVE to Barcelona
days.plan: Morning AVE to Barcelona (2h30, first class). Metro L3 to Passeig de Gracia; afternoon on the boulevard. Casa Batllo is four blocks from the Cotton House.

days.title: Sagrada Familia and Park Guell
days.plan: Sagrada Familia with early timed entry, then Park Guell. Evening seafood in Barceloneta.

days.title: Gothic Quarter and Picasso
days.plan: Gothic Quarter and the Picasso Museum; La Boqueria market lunch; sunset drink on the Cotton House's L'Atelier terrace.

days.title: Montserrat or Montjuic
days.plan: Choose: Montserrat by train + rack railway from Placa Espanya, or Montjuic cable car and MNAC.

days.title: Fly to Seville
days.plan: Nonstop flight to Seville (~1h45); EA bus or taxi; the hotel faces the Cathedral. Evening paseo through Santa Cruz's lanes.

days.title: Alcazar and flamenco
days.plan: Real Alcazar early with a private guide, then the Cathedral and (optional) Giralda climb, literally across the street from the hotel. Evening flamenco at a Triana tablao.

days.title: Cordoba day trip
days.plan: AVE/Avant from Santa Justa (45 min, ~38 trains daily, EUR 7-30 pp each way). Morning inside the Mezquita-Catedral before the crowds, wander the Jewish Quarter and cross the Roman bridge; lunch on salmorejo in a patio restaurant. Back in Seville by early evening for a farewell tapas crawl.

days.title: Back to Lisbon
days.plan: Plaza de Espana and Maria Luisa Park in the morning cool; last tapas lunch in Santa Cruz. Late-afternoon TAP hop to Lisbon (1h10; gain an hour). Check in at The Ivens; farewell dinner at Rocco and a last glass of vinho verde.

days.title: Fly to London
days.plan: Morning nonstop to London Heathrow (~2h45). Arrive early afternoon; Heathrow Express + taxi to County Hall. Evening walk along the South Bank; the London Eye is at the doorstep. Jennie departs LAX tonight.

days.title: Jennie arrives
days.plan: Morning: Westminster Abbey and the Churchill War Rooms, both just over the bridge. Jennie lands midday and joins you at County Hall; celebratory West End theatre night, the three of you.

days.title: Train to Manchester
days.plan: Late-morning Avanti from Euston (2h07); drop bags at the Kimpton Clocktower (check-in from 3 PM), a 10-minute walk from Piccadilly. Afternoon: Science and Industry Museum or a Man City stadium tour; dinner in Spinningfields.

days.title: OASIS - Night one
days.plan: OASIS AT THE ETIHAD, NIGHT ONE. Easy day in the Northern Quarter: record shops, cafes, Oasis's old stomping ground. Early dinner, then Metrolink to Etihad Campus.

days.title: OASIS - Night two
days.plan: OASIS AT THE ETIHAD, NIGHT TWO. Recover slowly; optional Liverpool half-day (~50 min by train, Beatles story at Albert Dock). Back for the Saturday show.

days.title: Back to London
days.plan: Avanti back to Euston by midday. Proper Sunday roast; lazy afternoon at the National Gallery or along the South Bank.

days.title: Windsor or Greenwich
days.plan: Day trip: Windsor Castle (~1h), or Greenwich by riverboat.

days.title: Tower and farewell dinner
days.plan: Tower of London early, then Borough Market for lunch. Farewell dinner at Gillray's overlooking the Thames.

days.title: Fly home
days.plan: Heathrow Express from Paddington (or pre-booked car); all three of you on the nonstop to LAX (~11h), landing early afternoon the same day.
